title: Chapter 392 The Source Of The Disaster
content:
Chapter 392 The Source Of The Disaster

The entire land of the gods suffered severe damage in an instant.

Countless cracks suddenly appeared on the six giant pillars of the sky, and the originally dazzling light became dim and dull at this moment.

"Who, who is it?!"

One of the giant pillars let out a hoarse roar, as if the evil ghost from hell had no trace of the glory of gods.

"Is it him?"

Another giant pillar had a solemn voice.

Hearing this, Gianthashima was silent for a moment, and the atmosphere suddenly became extremely depressing.

That, awesome guy.

For a moment, a deep sense of incredibility filled the hearts of the gods.

"impossible!"

A giant pillar spoke with a firm tone.

"If that guy is so strong, why don't he come in person? Haha, I see, he is also afraid of us. I'm afraid the price he will pay is not small."

After hearing this, the gods pondered for a moment and felt it was reasonable.

In their perception, there is almost no existence that is stronger than them.

They are confident, but at the same time, they are like frogs in a well, never seeing a truly vast sky.

.........

"Senior Lu, where is this place?"

Yueming followed Lu Daosheng, looking at the huge group of palaces ahead, his eyes full of shock.

These temple groups give people a strong sense of oppression. Even though they are now dilapidated, they can still see how glorious this place was.

Lu Daosheng didn't make a sound, but just continued to walk forward.

As the two of them got closer and closer, a strong sense of uneasiness suddenly floated.

"ah!"

Yueming screamed, his face pale, and his whole body trembled uncontrollably.

At this moment, he could no longer move forward.

Lu Daosheng stopped, looked back at Yueming, without saying anything, but waved his hand lightly.

Suddenly, the halo spread out and covered Yueming's body.

In an instant, Yueming recovered and took a heavy breath.

What kind of terrifying place is this?

What are you doing here, senior?

Yue Ming was full of doubts. No matter how smart he was, he naturally couldn't guess anything.

After all, his vision is limited.

But he was not very anxious either. As long as he followed Lu Daosheng, he would know immediately.

Walking among these huge temple groups, Yueming looked solemn. At this moment, he felt that he was as small as an ant, floating alone on the endless sea.

And Lu Daosheng was like an indestructible warship protecting him from moving forward.

There seemed to be no sign of life around.

But it is normal to think that ordinary lives can survive in such a terrifying aura.

How many people in the world are like a terrifying strong man like his senior?

And as he got closer and closer to the center, Yueming fell silent.

There were countless corpses appearing at their feet.

Some were broken, with only a few broken arm fragments left, while others were preserved intact, as if they were just sleeping.

And these corpses, without exception, were emitting extremely terrifying pressure.

It is no exaggeration to say that any of these corpses will be thrown into a world as powerful as their Moonlight Realm, which will directly crush their world.

How terrifying this is.

This is just a corpse. If it were their lifetime, then how terrifying would it be.

At this time, Yueming was full of thoughts in his heart, but he didn't dare to think too much.

Because these people are dead, how did they die?

On the side, Lu Daosheng seemed to see Yue Ming’s doubts and suddenly said, “Don’t think too much. When you are strong enough in the future, everything will be clear.”

Hearing this, Yueming nodded.

At this time, he noticed that at some point, they had arrived at the center of the temple group.

At this moment, an unimaginable hall in front of him stood in front of them.

"Senior, is this?"

"I'll know when I go in."

Lu Daosheng took the lead and walked towards the hall first.

Seeing this, Yueming did not dare to hesitate and hurriedly followed him.

As soon as they entered the hall, a hill made of broken corpses appeared before the two of them.

Around them are hills after hill.

These seem to be building blocks made by children, which look messy, but there are some rules.

"Come out, I'll see you."

At this moment, Lu Daosheng suddenly spoke.

When Yueming heard Lu Daosheng's words, he was shocked and quickly looked around, but he saw nothing.

At this time, behind the largest building block mountain, a timid figure slowly revealed his head.

She looked very cute, and her big eyes flashed at Lu Daosheng and the others, her eyes filled with fear, confusion and curiosity.

"ah?"

Seeing the target, Yueming couldn't help but be stunned. Isn't this a loli?

Hiss ~

Yueming couldn't help but secretly looked at Lu Daosheng with his light.

It turns out that senior is so good, he came here all the time to make this happen.

Lu Daosheng didn't expect Yue Ming to think of this thing in his mind at this moment. He looked at the little girl in the distance, with a slightly confused expression, but he still said, "If you don't show up again, don't blame me for being polite."

The voice fell, and the little girl hiding behind the building block mountain suddenly shook her whole body and walked out timidly.

Looking at Lu Daosheng and the others, she said coquettishly: "Who are you?"

Lu Daosheng did not answer. He looked at the little girl, remained silent for a moment, and asked, "Are you the Lord of Disaster?"

The little girl nodded slightly.

Lu Daosheng:...

Did you get something wrong?

Is this the Lord of Disaster?

What a joke.

"Come here."

Lu Daosheng waved to the little girl.

The little girl hesitated for a moment and walked slowly to Lu Daosheng.

She opened her eyes wide and looked at Lu Daosheng curiously.

Since she had memories, she had never seen a few living creatures. Any living creatures close to her had died, and most of them had not even seen her face.

The terrifying aura in this area was emitted from her body.

Even she couldn't control these things.

A natural disaster!

Next to Lu Daosheng, Yue Ming was already shocked and could not speak.

The Lord of Disaster? !

Legend has it that the source of disaster!

Just her? !

Lu Daosheng looked at the little girl and then slowly stretched out his hand.

The little girl was slightly stunned and subconsciously wanted to dodge, but then she was stunned.

I can't move anyway.

"No, don't hit me."

The little girl closed her eyes tightly, and she was so scared that she burst into tears.

But Lu Daosheng just gently put his hand on the little girl's head and felt the warmth coming from his head. The little girl was stunned. This was the first time that a creature had touched her.

Lu Daosheng didn't notice the little girl's strangeness, but just frowned.

This guy is indeed the source of the disaster.

He thought it would be some vicious monster, but he wanted the other party to pay the price.

But now, this guy is clearly a child who knows nothing.

This made him do what he could do.
